resources.string: Nozir tells you only what matters. Nobody reads the messages — the AI sums them up, and you know what to do.
Your number is verified by Telegram. Important messages come through the same bot.
Enter the code from the bot

When an SOS arrives the screen lights up and the alert shows at once. Otherwise it only makes a sound and waits in the shade. SOS only.
